core_obligations: Four borrowed cases (proof lines 720-721): the variable, abstraction, application and beta-redex rules are handled exactly as in the beta parallel substitution lemma.

proof_roadmap: Invert on the last rule of the eta-parallel derivation.
Reuse the beta-section argument for the first four rules.
Unfold the eta contraction through the substitution and close with the induction hypothesis.
